title: Chimerics
content:
:See also [[Lars]], a "chimera" created by a mortal (not Chimalia).
[[File:Manticore.gif|thumb|400px]]Chimerics are the creations of [[Chimalia]]. They were the forces used in the [[Chimerical Siege]] of the Shuttered City. They constructed Blackhorn's Maze ([[39.32]]).
